item.title: FSIS Shares Lessons Learned from Listeria Outbreak Linked to Meat and Poultry
item.description: The outbreak, linked to meat and poultry products produced by Yu Shang Food, sickened 24 people in nine states in 2024 and 2025. Twenty-two were hospitalized, and three died, according to the FSIS report.

item.title: FDA Releases the CORE 2024 Annual Report
item.description: In 2024, the agency's Office of Coordinated Outbreak Response, Evaluation, & Emergency Preparedness teams evaluated 72 incidents related to foodborne outbreaks, responded to 26 and issued advisories for 10.

item.title: Rep. DeLauro, Sen. Casey Introduce Infant Formula Made in America Act
item.description: The piece of legislation would create a new tax credit program to support new or expanding small U.S. infant formula producers.

item.title: Aston University and Mondelēz International Partner to Reimagine Food Engineering Technologies
item.description: Through projects supported by Mondelēz, Aston Institute for Membrane Excellence researchers will focus on harnessing taste receptor proteins found on the tongue, which will be used to develop experimental techniques that can capture and filter specific compounds in food, like those responsible for flavor or aroma.

item.title: ARS Researchers Create Indoor Air Scrubber That Purifies Air, Reduces Ammonia Levels
item.description: Researchers from USDA's Agricultural Research Service (ARS) developed an indoor air scrubber that purifies the air in chicken houses and reduces ammonia levels by 87% to 99%.

item.title: Mettler Toledo Launches eGuide on Preventing Physical Contamination
item.description: The eGuide explores five areas of food safety management: assessing risks, detecting weak points in production, choosing appropriate metal detection or x-ray technology, future-proofing inspection capabilities and leveraging digital data management to enhance compliance.

item.title: Food Safety Caucus Urges FDA to Force Raw Farm Recall in Response to E. Coli Outbreak
item.description: Seven people in three states — including three children under the age of 3 — have reported being sickened by E. coli contamination linked to Raw Farm’s cheese, said FDA. Two have been hospitalized.

item.title: Washington Confirms Bird Flu Detection in Skagit County
item.description: This marks the first detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza in a domestic flock in Skagit County, Wash.

item.title: Smarter Rodent Control Starts Here: QA Virtual Conference Set for April 1
item.description: QA is convening leading pest management professionals, food safety experts and industry peers to share proven practices, emerging innovations and real-world solutions for rodent control in food facilities.

item.title: USDA Promotes Voluntary ‘Product of USA’ Label
item.description: The label is reserved for meat, poultry and egg products from animals that were born, raised, harvested and processed in the United States.
